title: Our Planet: Trees and Rivers
text:
Trees are very important for our planet. They give us clean air to breathe. Birds build nests in the trees. Many animals live in forests too. We should protect trees and plant new ones.

A river is a big stream of water. Fish swim in the river and frogs sit on the rocks. People use river water to drink and to grow food. Some rivers are very clean. We must not throw trash in rivers.

questions.text: What do fish do in the river?
Why should we not throw trash in rivers?
options: Because trash can harm the water and the animals
Because fish like to eat trash
Because rivers need trash to grow

questions.text: What kind of person is the writer probably?
options: A person who cares about nature
A person who does not like animals
A person who lives only in a city

paragraph_translations: As árvores são muito importantes para o nosso planeta. Elas nos dão ar limpo para respirar. Os pássaros constroem ninhos nas árvores. Muitos animais também vivem nas florestas. Devemos proteger as árvores e plantar novas.

Um rio é um grande curso de água. Os peixes nadam no rio e os sapos ficam sentados nas pedras. As pessoas usam a água do rio para beber e para cultivar alimentos. Alguns rios são muito limpos. Nós não devemos jogar lixo nos rios.
